narrative.intro: Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As obligated $968M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As received 126 awards so far, with an average award size of $7.7M, and obligations are up 14.3% year over year. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As did most of this business with the Department of Defense, which accounted for $968M in obligations. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As has a concentrated market profile: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing is the largest NAICS market at $576M, followed by Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing at $222M, and Military Armored Vehicle, Tank, and Tank Component Manufacturing at $111M. Historical obligations show growth into FY2026, with FY25 obligations at $847M and FY26 obligations at $968M. Current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. This brief summarizes where Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As is winning federal work and which markets and agencies account for the bulk of the obligations.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As federal obligations?
sections.body: Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As obligations are highly concentrated with the Department of Defense, which obligated $968M. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As has significant exposure to a small set of NAICS markets, with $576M in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing and $222M in Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As recorded $968M in FY26 to date after $847M in FY25, showing most recent year-over-year growth of up 14.3%.

sections.heading: What product and service areas dominate Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As federal awards?
sections.body: Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As is dominated by missile propulsion and related systems, with $576M in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing and $9.1M in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As also sells systems and instruments, reflected in $222M for Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing, and has smaller engineering and R&D obligations at $7.1M and $4.7M respectively.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As?
faq.a: The Department of Defense buys most federal work from Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As, with $968M in obligations. The Department of the Interior is the only other listed buying agency, with $72.5K in obligations.

faq.q: What does Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As sell to the government?
faq.a: Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As sells missile propulsion systems and related components, shown by $576M in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Propulsion Unit and Propulsion Unit Parts Manufacturing and $9.1M in Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing. Kongsberg Defence and Aerospace As also provides systems and instruments, with $222M in Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing, and smaller amounts in Engineering Services ($7.1M) and R&D ($4.7M).
